## Description and Rationale

I am a Master's student in Aviation at Zurich University of Applied Sciences. I also work as a research assistant at the Centre for Aviation. Both my studies and my work focus on airport-related applications of data science, machine learning, and deep learning. I want to use this competition as an opportunity to challenge myself and further develop my skills.
